newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk firefighters bring forest blaze under control.
newsitem.headline: Turk firefighters bring forest blaze under control.

text.p: Turkish emergency services using aircraft brought under control on Wednesday a blaze near a popular Mediterranean holiday resort, officials said.
"It is under control. No residential areas are under threat," said Hasan Gezgin, spokesman for the forestry department in the resort town of Marmaris.
The fire which started on Monday afternoon covered an area of around a thousand hectares (2,500 acres) and was approaching two residential areas, several km (miles) from Marmaris by Tuesday.
Two airplanes and seven helicopters supported fire crews from across the region in fighting the blaze.
Gezgin said efforts to cool some areas still smouldering after the fire were continuing.
